title: The Deepfake Election
briefing: Three days before a general election, audio appears to show a senior politician admitting corruption. It has 14 million views. Forensic analysis cannot yet say whether it is real.

briefingSignal.leansTrue: First forensic read, low confidence: no synthesis artefacts found so far. The recording may be authentic.
briefingSignal.leansFalse: First forensic read, low confidence: spectral irregularities consistent with synthesis. The recording may be fabricated.

shah.stance: Forensics needs 48 hours we do not have. Anything we assert now, we assert without evidence.

harcourt.stance: If this is a hostile operation, silence is the outcome it was designed to produce. Say what we know and how we will find out.

chen.stance: Whatever you do, do not be the government that leaned on platforms three days before a vote.

okafor.stance: Fourteen million views and rising. Slow it down and label it; do not take it down.

choices.headline: Government declines to comment on the recording until forensic analysis is complete.

choices.text: State that the recording is unverified and explain the forensic process.
choices.headline: Officials say the recording is unverified and set out how it is being tested.

choices.text: Ask platforms to add friction and labels, not removal.
choices.headline: Platforms add sharing friction and an 'unverified' label to the recording at the government's request.

choices.text: Emergency provenance rules for political media.
choices.headline: Emergency provenance rules for political media are laid before Parliament; they will not bind before polling day.

choices.text: Publish an authentication result within 12 hours.
choices.headline: The national provenance service publishes an authentication result within 12 hours.

evidencePanel.known: A study of the 2024 UK and European elections found no evidence that AI content changed results, but signs of damage to trust in the information environment.
evidencePanel.unknown: Whether this recording is real, and whether anyone will believe the answer when it comes.
evidencePanel.whyItMatters: Every option is a bet on authenticity made before the evidence arrives.

sources.label: CETaS, AI-Enabled Influence Operations: Threat Analysis of the 2024 UK and European Elections
